channel.title: Somonitor
channel.description: Somonitor is an always-on social listening app: share of voice, conversation signals and crisis alerts, each traceable to real posts.

item.title: Share of voice that means something: beyond mention counts
item.description: Share of voice by mention count rewards noise. Here is how to measure share of conversation by theme, emotion and tension, with evidence you can check.

item.title: Listening vs tracking: the ethics of hearing your audience
item.description: Audiences distrust brands that know them too well. Why listening beats tracking, plus a practical code for ethical social listening.

item.title: Crisis early warning: reading the signals before they trend
item.description: Most social crises are visible hours or days before they trend. The signals to watch, a triage framework and how to avoid crying wolf.

item.title: How to measure audiences across platforms consistently
item.description: Every platform reports engagement differently. A practical method for one consistent read of audiences across social platforms, using shared concepts.

item.title: Niche fandoms: why small communities set the tone
item.description: Broad listening misses small, intense communities like women's football fans. How to find niche fandoms, read them respectfully and act early.

item.title: Why every AI listening conclusion should be checkable
item.description: AI summaries make listening fast but can be confidently wrong. Why every conclusion should trace to its posts, and how to audit one.

item.title: Beyond sentiment: reading tones, emotions and tensions
item.description: Positive, negative, neutral hides what people mean. How tones, emotions and tensions give social listening a sharper, more useful reading of conversation.

item.title: Segmenting Gen Z by conversation, not birth year
item.description: Gen Z is not one audience. How social listening reveals the communities, tensions and codes that actually segment younger audiences across Southeast Asia.

item.title: Generative AI is changing brand visibility. Listen first
item.description: AI assistants now summarise what people say about brands. Why social conversation shapes AI answers, and how listening helps you see what they will say.

item.title: How to set up always-on social listening that people use
item.description: Most listening dashboards are abandoned within months. A practical setup for always-on brand listening: queries, rhythms, owners and alerts that stick.
